title: Figure 5: Silicone (PDMS) repeating unit chemical structure
description: Structural formula of the polydimethylsiloxane repeating unit: an -O-Si- backbone with two CH3 groups on silicon, enclosed in brackets with subscript n. Caption: "Figure 5. Silicone Chemical Groups." It appears in the 'Silicone Chemistry' section of a biomaterials report.
